subject: QBR prep: ACME pipeline review, forecast consolidation, and account one-pagers
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-04T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR request — pipeline review + asks

Hi Chloe / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we start prepping for ACME's internal QBR next Tuesday, procurement and the business leaders have asked for a concise Redwood packet: account-level summaries, our current forecast by close date, and any supporting mutual action plan so procurement can align on timelines.

Can you provide: 
- Per-account one-pagers for the 6 opportunities we're tracking (ARR, close probability, expected close month)
- A consolidated forecast rollup (best / expected / worst) for Q2
- Any security/compliance notes we should share with IT (SOC2 evidence id or pointer is fine)

I've attached ACME_QBR_requests.xlsx with the column format they'd like to see. If you can get a first pass by COB Friday (3/5) that would keep us on schedule.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 20m call if helpful.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Enterprise Programs
ACME Corp

Attachment: ACME_QBR_requests.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-04T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR request — pipeline review + asks

Hi Priya — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear template.

High level plan from our side:
1) Internal owners (cc'd) will produce account one-pagers and an accompanying rollup. Rishi will lead the forecast consolidation; Marissa will draft the customer-facing one-pagers; I will own the final deck and approvals.
2) We'll deliver a consolidated rollup (best/expected/worst) and the first-pass one-pagers by EOD Friday 3/5. If anything looks off, we'll flag it early.
3) We can include a short SOC2 pointer in the appendix — will reference our audit id and provide a redacted evidence list.

Two quick asks for you to help speed this:
- Please confirm the six opportunity names that must be included (we matched to the file you attached but want to be explicit).
- If procurement requires a specific DocuSign timeline, share the link/requirement and we'll annotate the mutual action plan.

I've attached a starter mutual action plan (ACME_mutual_action_plan.docx) that maps deadlines and decision owners; we'll update that after internal sync.

Proposed internal timeline: internal sync 9:30am PT today (I'll send a calendar invite), delivery 3/5 EOD, final deck 3/8 EOD.

If that works I'll get the invite out now.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Sr. Account Exec — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ACME_mutual_action_plan.docx (template, 18KB)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-04T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR request — pipeline review + asks

Chloe / Marissa — quick pipeline snapshot after a fast scrub this morning. I'll pull raw numbers from SFDC and drop the consolidated sheet into the Drive link. Quoting Chloe's plan below for context.

Account-level quick notes (prob / ARR / expected close):
- ACME-Platform (acct: ACME-PF): 60% / $420k ARR / May-2027 — On plan, customer engineering POC complete, legal review started.
- ACME-Retail (acct: ACME-RT): 30% / $275k ARR / Jun-2027 — Pricing pushback; procurement pushing for a 12-mo term and lower initial unit price.
- ACME-Data (acct: ACME-DATA): 80% / $180k ARR / Apr-2027 — Proof-of-value succeeded, waiting for final signoff.
- ACME-Infra (acct: ACME-INF): 10% / $95k ARR / Jul-2027 — Long procurement lead; needs executive sponsorship.
- ACME-Security (acct: ACME-Sec): 45% / $210k ARR / May-2027 — Security team raised a couple of compliance questions (requested SOC2 scoping).
- ACME-Intl (acct: ACME-INTL): 25% / $150k ARR / Jun-2027 — Region-specific hosting questions; potential delay.

Preliminary consolidated forecast for Q2 (sum of the six):
- Best: $1.45M
- Expected: $1.03M (probability-weighted)
- Worst: $0.58M

Risks to call out: pricing pushback on ACME-RT; SOC2 evidence timing for ACME-Sec; INF vertical is low-prob but large gating by procurement.

I've uploaded a draft packet (QBR_acct_summaries_v1.pdf) to the Drive link and will refine after your feedback.

--Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Strategy Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR_acct_summaries_v1.pdf (draft summaries, 240KB)
Drive: https://drive.redd/ACME_QBR_packet

Team — good start. Two tactical asks before we send to Priya:
1) Consolidated forecast needs a single-line executive summary at the top (one sentence: expected revenue and primary risks).
2) Create best/expected/worst scenarios with the assumptions listed (what closes, what slips). Put the assumptions in the appendix so the ACME execs can see the drivers.

Also loop in Solutions (if needed) to answer hosting/region questions for ACME-INTL. Marissa — please prioritize the ACME-RT pricing play and include the alternate pricing table.

I expect a clean packet by EOD so we can hand it to Priya for their internal QBR. If anything blocks you escalate to me by 3pm.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks,
